blocks.text: Powerful where it counts and smart where it matters, Galaxy S25 FE is built to level up your everyday. items.label: BIG. BRIGHT. SMOOTH
items.value: Enjoy every scroll, swipe and stream on a stunning 6.7” wide display that’s as smooth for scrolling as it is immersive.¹

items.label: LIGHTWEIGHT DESIGN, EVERYDAY EASE
items.value: With a lightweight build and slim profile, Galaxy S25 FE is made for life on the go. It is powerful and portable and won't weigh you down no matter where your day takes you.

items.label: SELFIES THAT STUN
items.value: Every selfie’s a standout with Galaxy S25 FE. Snap sharp shots and vivid videos thanks to the 12MP selfie camera with ProVisual Engine.

items.label: MOVE IT. REMOVE IT. IMPROVE IT
items.value: Generative Edit² on Galaxy S25 FE lets you move, resize and erase distracting elements in your shot. Galaxy AI intuitively recreates every detail so each shot looks exactly the way you envisioned.³

items.label: MORE POWER. LESS PLUGGING IN⁵
items.value: Busy day? No worries. Galaxy S25 FE is built with a powerful 4,900mAh battery that’s ready to go the distance⁴. And when you need a top off, Super Fast Charging 2.0⁵ gets you back in action.

items.label: PACKED WITH STRENGTH, FOR YOUR EVERYDAY
items.value: Life happens. That’s why Galaxy S25 FE is built with a sturdy Armor Aluminum frame and Gorilla Glass Victus+ to handle life’s everyday wear and tear.⁶

items.label: POWERFUL PERFORMANCE, NOW ACCESSIBLE
items.value: You shouldn’t feel like your phone’s holding you back. Galaxy S25 FE speeds things up with a premium chipset and keeps your day going with sustained performance, thanks to its improved cooling system.

items.label: SHOW GEMINI, GET INSTANT HELP
items.value: Sometimes it’s easier to show than explain.⁷ Go live with Google Gemini and share your camera to get helpful real-time answers from your smart assistant.

items.label: SEE IT BIG. HEAR IT BETTER
items.value: Pair the powerful sound of your Galaxy Buds3 FE with the wide and vibrant display of your Galaxy S25 FE⁸ for a truly immersive experience. They bring every movie, video and game to life.

items.label: Compatible Devices
items.value: Android, Bluetooth Universal, Samsung, Wifi Universal

items.value: Built-In GPS, Fast Charging Support, Fingerprint Sensor, Water Resistant, Wireless Charging
